arxiv-2106-10601.title: ReGO: Reference-Guided Outpainting for Scenery Image
arxiv-2106-10601.creator: Yaxiong Wang, Yunchao Wei, Xueming Qian, Li Zhu, Yi Yang
arxiv-2106-10601.description: Abstract We aim to tackle the challenging yet practical scenery image outpainting task in this work. Recently, generative adversarial learning has significantly advanced the image outpainting by producing semantic consistent content for the given image. However, the existing methods always suffer from the blurry texture and the artifacts of the generative part, making the overall outpainting results lack authenticity.

arxiv-2205-02813.title: On a gap in the proof of the generalised quantum Stein’s lemma and its consequences for the reversibility of quantum resources
arxiv-2205-02813.creator: Mario Berta, Fernando G. S. L. Brandão, Gilad Gour, Ludovico Lami, Martin B. Plenio, Bartosz Regula, Marco Tomamichel
arxiv-2205-02813.description: Abstract We show that the proof of the generalised quantum Stein’s lemma [Brandão & Plenio, Commun. Math. Phys. 295, 791 (2010) ] is not correct due to a gap in the argument leading to Lemma III.9. Hence, the main achievability result of Brandão & Plenio is not known to hold.

arxiv-2301-13555.title: Random matrices associated to Young diagrams
arxiv-2301-13555.creator: Fabio Deelan Cunden, Marilena Ligabò, Tommaso Monni
arxiv-2301-13555.description: Abstract We consider the singular values of certain Young diagram shaped random matrices. For block-shaped random matrices, the empirical distribution of the squares of the singular eigenvalues converges almost surely to a distribution whose moments are a generalisation of the Catalan numbers.

arxiv-2308-12360.title: Turing patterns on a two-component isotropic growing system. Part 2: Conditions based on a potential function for exponential growth/shrinkage
arxiv-2308-12360.creator: Aldo Ledesma-Durán
arxiv-2308-12360.description: Abstract We propose conditions for the emergence of Turing patterns in a domain that changes in size by homogeneous growth/shrinkage. These conditions to determine the bifurcation are based on considering the geometric change of a potential function whose evolution determines the stability of the trajectories of all the Fourier modes of the perturbation.

arxiv-2407-01562.title: Small but Fair! Fairness for Multimodal Human-Human and Robot-Human Mental Wellbeing Coaching Thanks: ∗ equal contribution, alphabetical order
arxiv-2407-01562.creator: Jiaee Cheong*, Micol Spitale*, Hatice Gunes
arxiv-2407-01562.description: Abstract In recent years, the affective computing (AC) and human-robot interaction (HRI) research communities have put fairness at the centre of their research agenda. However, none of the existing work has addressed the problem of machine learning (ML) bias in HRI settings.

arxiv-2407-16544.title: Real-Time Out-of-Equilibrium Quantum Dynamics in Disordered Materials
arxiv-2407-16544.creator: Luis M. Canonico, Stephan Roche, Aron W. Cummings
arxiv-2407-16544.description: Abstract We report a linear-scaling numerical method for exploring nonequilibrium electron dynamics in systems of arbitrary complexity. Based on the Chebyshev expansion of the time evolution of the single-particle density matrix, the method gives access to nonperturbative excitation and relaxation phenomena in models of disordered materials with sizes on the experimental scale.

arxiv-2512-15951.title: Multicategorical Adjoints, Monadicity, and Quantum Resources
arxiv-2512-15951.creator: Shih-Yu Chang
arxiv-2512-15951.description: Abstract This paper is the third part of a program aimed at building a unified operadic and multicategorical foundation for operator theory and quantum processes. Building on the multicategory HilbMult and the previously introduced Synergy Operad, we investigate the intrinsic algebraic structure underlying compositional quantum dynamics. Three main themes are developed.

We conducted an online randomized controlled trial to compare the effect of HIV-testi

pmc-10672763.title: The Left Atrial Area Derived Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance Left Ventricular Filling Pressure Equation Shows Superiority over Integrated Echocardiography
pmc-10672763.creator: Ciaran Grafton-Clarke, Gareth Matthews, Rebecca Gosling, Peter Swoboda, Alexander Rothman, Jim M Wild, David G Kiely, Robin Condliffe, Samer Alabed, Andrew J Swift, Pankaj Garg, Marco Fogante
pmc-10672763.description: Background and objectives: Evaluating left ventricular filling pressure (LVFP) plays a crucial role in diagnosing and managing heart failure (HF). While traditional assessment methods involve multi-parametric transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) or right heart catheterisation (RHC), cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) has emerged as a valuable diagnostic tool in HF.

pmc-11428110.title: Machine learning for identifying risk of death in patients with severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome
pmc-11428110.creator: Qionghan He, Zihao You, Qiuping Dong, Jiale Guo, Zhaoru Zhang
pmc-11428110.description: BackgroundSevere fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) has attracted attention due to the rising incidence and high severity and mortality rates. This study aims to construct a machine learning (ML) model to identify SFTS patients at high risk of death early in hospital admission, and to provide early intensive intervention with a view to reducing the risk of death.

pmc-11439321.title: Liquid-liquid extraction of selenium (IV) ions from hydrochloric acid solution using Aliquat 336 dissolved in kerosene
pmc-11439321.creator: Mohamed I Aly, S E Rizk
pmc-11439321.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Solvent extraction of selenium(IV) ions from highly concentrated hydrochloric acid using 0.4 mol/L Aliquat 336 dissolved in kerosene was investigated. As a modifying agent, 1-octanol (10% v/v) was added to the organic phase to avoid the third phase formation. The effect of different parameters affecting the liquid-liquid extraction of selenium(IV) such as the acid concentration, shaking time, metal ion concentration in the aqueous phase, loading capacity, diluents, and temperature, was studied.

pmc-11520939.title: Serum Procalcitonin, Hematology Parameters, and Cell Morphology in Multiple Clinical Conditions and Sepsis
pmc-11520939.creator: Pingfeng Feng, Yongjian He, Ping Guan, Chaohui Duan, Junjie Huang, Zhixin Chai, Jingjing Wang, Huifei Zheng, Junxu Luo, Yuhuan Shi, Xin Li, Huayi Huang
pmc-11520939.description: BackgroundThe clinical value of procalcitonin (PCT) in infection diagnosis and antibiotic stewardship is still unclear. This study aimed to investigate the association between serum PCT and different clinical conditions as well as other infectious/inflammatory parameters in different septic patients in order to elucidate the value of PCT detection in infection management.MethodsChemiluminescence immunoassay was used for serum PCT analysis.

pmc-11529240.title: Examining select sociodemographic characteristics of sub-county geographies for public health surveillance
pmc-11529240.creator: D Aaron Vinson, Angela K Werner
pmc-11529240.description: BackgroundMapping health outcomes related to environmental health hazards at the county level can lead to a simplification of risks experienced by populations in that county. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s National Environmental Public Health Tracking Program has developed sub-county geographies that aggregate census tracts to allow for stable, minimally suppressed data to be displayed.

pmc-11670816.title: Reduced auditory perception and brain response with quiet TMS coil
pmc-11670816.creator: David L.K. Murphy, Lari M. Koponen, Eleanor Wood, Yiru Li, Noreen Bukhari-Parlakturk, Stefan M. Goetz, Angel V. Peterchev
pmc-11670816.description: Background:Electromagnetic forces in transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) coils generate a loud clicking sound that produces confounding auditory activation and is potentially hazardous to hearing. To reduce this noise while maintaining stimulation efficiency similar to conventional TMS coils, we previously developed a quiet TMS double containment coil (qTMS-DCC).

pmc-11689823.description: The intent of research is to inform practice and policy to benefit society. pmc-12639012.title: Analysis of inverse problem for pseudo-hyperbolic equation under periodic boundary condition
pmc-12639012.creator: İrem Bağlan, Akbala Yernazar, Erman Aslan, Hüseyin Budak, Miguel Vivas-Cortez
pmc-12639012.description: This research paper investigates an inverse problem involving time-dependent unknown coefficients in a one-dimensional nonlinear pseudo-hyperbolic equation with nonlocal boundary conditions. The Fourier method is employed, and the convergence, uniqueness, and stability of the solution are demonstrated. Additionally, the Finite Difference Method (FDM) is applied to address the inverse problem numerically.

pmc-12756812.title: Structures and Chemical Bonding of B5O7 +/0/– with a Hexagonal B3O3 Ring†
pmc-12756812.creator: Shu-Juan Gao, Chong Hu, Feng Li, Ling Wang
pmc-12756812.description: This work aims to illustrate the influence of a single electron on the bonding properties and geometric structure of a benzene-like cluster, using B5O7 +/0/– as an exemplar. The inherent electron deficiency of boron dictates not only the rich structural variety of boron oxide clusters but also their unique electronic characteristics and unconventional bonding schemes.
